attribution_limitations: The text says the breast milk peak was reached 2.75 h after chemotherapy and that milk samples were collected at 2.75 h, but Table 1 labels the corresponding breast milk row 3 h (111.4 ng/mL). The two time labels are not reconciled in the source.
Method lists maternal plasma sampling at 0.25 to 2.00, 2.50, 3.50, 4.50, 6.50 and 8.50 h, but Table 1 has plasma values at 3 h and 6 h and none at 6.5 h or 8.5 h.
The text lists nine selectively analysed breast milk time points beyond 24 h (27.00 to 359.75 h) but Table 1 also has a 193 h row not in that list; table times 22.5 and 22.50 agree.
Text reports peak plasma paclitaxel 2050 ng/mL at 1 h while Table 1 prints 2050.92 ng/mL at 1 h.

Paclitaxel course length is not fully reconciled: nine weekly cycles were administered with a shorter course delivered for neurotoxicity concerns, chemotherapy was paused after six cycles at 36 weeks, and samples were taken after the 9th week.

The abstract says breast milk paclitaxel levels drop below the minimum quantifiable dose at 72 h following chemotherapy, while the Results, Discussion and Table 1 give 71.25 h. Treated as an approximation in the abstract (rounding), not a source conflict; the recorded fact uses the Results and table time.
